title: 5250 operator error behavior
summary: Structured field mutation and terminal-like cursor-relative typing are intentionally different abstractions. Invalid cursor-relative typing may lock the keyboard with structured operator-error evidence; the implementation must not silently move the cursor to rescue the operation.
invariants: PROTECTED_AREA is a local operator error, not a new host semantic state.
Structured setField may succeed where typeAtCursor correctly fails because they model different operator semantics.

provenance.claim: Supports this Terminal Machine/TN5250 continuity article.
